title: Design schema
description: The design-system contract captured by the design-clone skill's extractor and consumed by its apply path (ravenclaude-core): spacing scale, type scale, grid/breakpoints, elevation, and component recipes — beyond brand-kit's logo/color/typography tokens. Every value self-declares HOW it was captured via `capture_method`, carried both document-level (the ceiling of what this extraction pass could produce) and per-dimension (the honesty pivot: v1's static producer stamps every dimension "static"; a dimension may never claim a fidelity its document-level pass could not have produced). Instance-conformance is enforced by scripts/check-design-schema.py, NOT by validate-schemas.yml. See docs/plans (FORGE design-schema-mimicry) and plugins/ravenclaude-core/skills/design-clone/SKILL.md.

source.description: Provenance of the reference page this schema was captured from.

url.description: The reference page this schema was captured from.

capture_method.description: Document-level capture method: the CEILING of fidelity this extraction pass could produce. v1 ships only "static" (declared-CSS parsing, no browser CSSOM); "computed" is reserved for a future browser-driven producer. No per-dimension capture_method may exceed this ceiling — see check-design-schema.py's provenance-honesty check.

spacing.description: The derived spacing scale (margin/padding/gap literals clustered to a base unit).

base_unit.description: Fitted base unit in px (e.g. 8), or null when no clean base-unit fit was found (degrade honestly, see confidence_notes).

scale.description: Sorted distinct spacing values observed (px), possibly empty on degrade.

type_scale.description: The derived type scale (font-size literals clustered to a ratio).

base_size.description: Fitted base font size in px, or null on degrade.

ratio.description: Fitted scale ratio (e.g. 1.25), or null when no ratio fit was within tolerance (degrade honestly, raw sizes still carried).

sizes.description: Sorted distinct font-size values observed (px), possibly empty on degrade.

grid.description: The derived grid/breakpoint system (declared @media values + container max-width).

breakpoints.description: Declared @media breakpoint values (raw, e.g. "768px"), possibly empty on degrade.

columns.description: Column count, when a declared grid-template-columns count was found; null on degrade.

gutter.description: Declared gutter/gap value (raw CSS length), or null.

container_max.description: Declared container max-width (raw CSS length), or null.

shadows.description: Distinct box-shadow declarations (raw CSS), ordered as an ascending ramp by parsed blur/spread; possibly empty on degrade.

components.description: Recurring component recipes found in declared CSS (structure only, e.g. button/card/nav/input).

brand_kit_ref.description: Optional pointer (path or URL) to a sibling brand-kit.schema.json instance captured from the same reference.

identity_flags.description: Advisory flags for anything the apply path must never carry over verbatim (logos, signature colors, mascots). Never auto-approves; action is always a human/reviewer call.

confidence_notes.description: Free-text notes on degraded/uncertain derivations (e.g. why base_unit or ratio came back null).

capture_method.description: "static" = parsed from declared CSS only (stdlib, no browser). "computed" = read from a browser's rendered CSSOM (getComputedStyle) — reserved; v1 ships no computed producer.

anatomy.description: Structural parts recognized within the component, e.g. ["icon", "label"].

recipe.description: Declared CSS property/value pairs for this component (e.g. padding, border-radius, box-shadow). Open map: property names are not enumerable ahead of time.

evidence.description: Why this was flagged (selector, frequency, or heuristic that fired).

action.description: Recommended handling. Never auto-applied by the extractor; the apply path's hard no-read invariant is the actual defense, this is the advisory layer.
